says: Reading the profile first (access.profile.read) shows it active at access generation 7, opened by the device key. A person with a bound repository and a committed instructions source has a read of that source sealed at that generation when they lock the profile (access.transition lock: locked, generation 8). The locked entry (surface.drive from the locked scope entrance) shows only that the profile is locked, how to unlock at a terminal, and an unlock action; Down, Tab and Enter move nothing and unlock nothing, and every frame stays access locked with nothing dispatched or called. The read arriving late is not admitted (access.admission.decide: access_locked). An unlock naming no explicit method is refused at admission (variant_mismatch /change). The person unlocks explicitly with the device key at a terminal (active again, still generation 8: only a restriction moves the generation); the late read, still sealed at generation 7, is again not admitted (access_generation_moved) rather than delivered into the reopened session, while the same read sealed afresh at generation 8 for the same actor and repository is allowed. Negative: no frame shows the source's path, title, counts or repository name while locked; navigation never changes access; and the late read never becomes admitted under the new generation.
